entries:
Alpha 1.79.79 (Dungeon masonry and quest rewards)

  • Reaching level 10 now shows a specialization reminder with a button that opens the selection menu.
  • Every second story chapter offers one choice from six random quest-level equipment items, guaranteed green or better with improved blue and orange chances.
  • Quest item choices stay saved across reconnects. Claim from the conversation or Journal when you have a free bag slot.
  • Treasure vaults, shrine chapels, ambush galleries, guard courts and passage aisles now have distinct stone floor layouts.
  • Ambush rooms replace plain dark spikes with weathered, coursed stone piers.
  • Existing entry, boss approach and arena floor arrangements remain familiar.
  • Room objectives, interaction spaces, collision and earned progress retain their existing rules.
  • Dungeon masonry shares the existing material and rendering resources.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.78 (Backup and recovery tools)

  • Operators can create a verified recovery point between game updates.
  • Standalone capture restarts the same previously running server and preserves stopped services.
  • Recovery tools refuse overlapping deployments, backups and restores.
  • Verified recovery sets can be copied to an explicitly approved SSH destination.
  • The operator guide explains verification, failure handling and remaining recovery-policy choices.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.77 (Quest map guidance and dungeon finish)

  • Stone and iron at dungeon entrances now share a more consistent worn finish.
  • Show quest on map finds your next mapped objective or turn-in from the journal and Lore Book.
  • Return to map restores your search and filters without changing tracked quests.
  • Lore Book reading keeps its focus as newly learned names and memories update the page.
  • Manual quest tracking is verified across a fresh saved-character login.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.76 (Cleaner character preparation)

  • Improved cleanup after character appearances load and equipment is released.
  • Queued appearance loading is cancelled promptly when a character is removed.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.75 (Clearer danger warnings and character rendering)

  • Danger warnings briefly soften ordinary combat sounds and world ambience so warnings are easier to hear.
  • Your volume settings and directional warning cues stay in effect.
  • Characters render more efficiently after appearing or ending stealth.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.74 (People, places and woodland leaf detail)

  • The Lore Book adds People and Places browsing based on your earned memories.
  • Read the original account and return to your previous search and selection.
  • The Lore Book and witness conversations keep keyboard focus as new story records arrive.
  • Conversation questions have roomier phone touch targets.
  • Earth's bracken and sedge gain finer leaf surfaces.
  • Future story outcomes stay unrevealed; quest acceptance and rewards remain manual.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.73 (Town surfaces, visible story markers and Low housing)

  • Lanternhold's central court uses quieter, mixed-width worn flagstones.
  • Party markers remain visible across Water, Fire and Air story-site paving and shallow reflective pools.
  • Story-site walls, magical ripples, interactions and travel routes retain their existing positions.
  • Low graphics reduce off-screen residential rendering on more browsers while preserving the visible town.
  • The Player Guide explains the garment row, complete armor outfits, independent held looks and restoring original gear.
  • Guide sections explain Lore Book memories, current quests, tracking and saved window positions.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.72 (Dark Realm records and worn flagstones)

  • Dark Realm record buildings have worn stone walls, recessed joints and fitted paving.
  • Archives hold shelves, documents and work tables suited to their stories.
  • Ferry shelters show seating and supplies; the stayers’ shelter has benches and rolled bedding.
  • The unfinished celebration has a laid table, hanging banner and an empty chair.
  • Party markers remain visible across story-site bases and the record buildings’ shallow floors.
  • Quieter, mixed-width flagstones soften the repeated paving across the expedition.
  • Closing Settings and shared modal windows immediately returns control to gameplay keys.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.71 (Grounded expeditions and dungeon floors)

  • Party and hostile ground markers stay visible across Dark Realm streets and dungeon floors.
  • Worn side streets lead to the existing Dark Realm records, with matching routes on the instance map.
  • Dungeon paving, boss inlays and entry thresholds sit below ordinary markers while keeping their original walkways.
  • Buried surfaces no longer bleed through flush dungeon stone at gameplay zoom.
  • The crypt uses its own floor and restores the town environment when you leave.
  • The garment collection’s source records are available from Credits & notices.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.70 (Grounded arenas and visible markers)

  • Party and hostile markers stay visible across the arena floor and its decorative circles.
  • The sparring court has dressed stone edges and a foundation, with clearer separation from the overworld.
  • Casino carpets and medallions keep ordinary party and hostile rings visible on both floors.
  • Four-class practice duels verify combat and return to town without ranked rewards.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.
